program = '''def transform(grid):
    def rotate_cw(matrix):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*matrix[::-1])]

    original = [row[:] for row in grid]
    clockwise = rotate_cw(original)
    half_turn = rotate_cw(rotate_cw(original))
    counterclockwise = rotate_cw(half_turn)
    top = [a + b for a, b in zip(original, clockwise)]
    bottom = [a + b for a, b in zip(counterclockwise, half_turn)]
    return top + bottom
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
ns={}
exec(compile(program,str(p),'exec'),ns)
transform=ns['transform']
